target: delivery_delay_days, conditional on the order being late (delivery_delay_days > 0)
leakage_guard: identical feature set to the delivery-lateness classifier; delivery_delay_days and is_late are used only as the label / row filter, never as predictors
not_a_causal_claim: this model estimates historical association between pre-purchase order attributes and delay magnitude GIVEN lateness; it does not estimate how any intervention would change that magnitude
